import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class CF552C{ 
  public static int k, w;
  public static HashSet<Long> set;
  public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception {
    Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
    java.io.PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    
    w = in.nextInt();
    long n = in.nextLong();
    
    k = 0;
    for(int i = 0; w > 2 && i < 21; i++){
      k = i;
      if(Math.pow(w, i) > 1e9){
        break;
      }
    }
    
    set = new HashSet<Long>();
    if(w > 2) solve(0, 0);
    
    boolean bol = false;
    if(w == 2) bol = true;
    
    for(long i : set){
      if(i >= n && set.contains(i-n)){
        bol = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    
    if(bol) pw.println("YES");
    else pw.println("NO");
    
    pw.close();
  }
  
  static void solve(int i, long sum){
    if(i > k){
      set.add(sum);
      return;
    }
    
    solve(i+1, sum+(long)Math.pow(w, i));
    solve(i+1, sum);
  }
    
  
  static class Scanner {
    public java.util.Scanner scanner;
    
    public Scanner(InputStream stream) {
      scanner = new java.util.Scanner(stream);
    }
    
    public String next() {
      return scanner.next();
    }
    
    public int nextInt() {
      return scanner.nextInt();
    }
    
    public long nextLong() {
      return scanner.nextLong();
    }
  }
}
